activity.subtitle: A record of user creation, deactivation, reactivation, deletion, and password resets.
activity.title: System activity

title: User management
subtitle: Deactivation is reversible; deletion is not, and clears the account data.

deactivate.title: Deactivate account
deactivate.note: They will be signed out immediately and cannot sign in again. Existing assignments and history are unaffected, and this can be undone later.

reactivate.title: Reactivate account
reactivate.note: They will be able to sign in again, but previous sessions are not restored.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.description: The account data (username, password, avatar) will be erased and cannot be recovered. The display name and existing cards, reviews and activity records are kept so history stays readable.
delete.typeToConfirm: Type the display name {{name}} to confirm

resetPassword.title: Reset password
resetPassword.hint: After you set it, pass it to them offline through a secure channel. All of their current sessions will be signed out.
